content.title: Alatau general plan · block layout around block 479341
content.description: The general plan lays the land out anew: every zone is its own lot (land readjustment). Plots in order: 1 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479336; 2 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479340; 3 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479341; 4 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479343; 5 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479346; 6 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479350; 7 Multi-storey housing (6–12 floors), zone 479492; 8 High-rise housing (over 12 floors), zone 482147; 9 High-rise housing (over 12 floors), zone 482149; 10 Parks and squares, zone 476365; 11 Parks and squares, zone 476370; 12 Public and protective greenery, zone 480457; 13 Public and protective greenery, zone 480511 (district part); 14 Public and protective greenery, zone 480585; 15 Public and protective greenery, zone 480588; 16 Public and protective greenery, zone 480589; 17 Public and protective greenery, zone 480595; 18 Roads, zone 480997 (district part). 1254 m² inside the district carry no zone and stay as they are. Restated from the functional zones of the Alatau general plan (Decree No. 727 of 9 September 2025) in the state urban-planning cadastre (map.gov4c.kz, layer kz:gpzone).
